newsitem.title: UK: British woman expecting octuplets loses 3 babies.
newsitem.headline: British woman expecting octuplets loses 3 babies.

text.p: A British woman expecting octuplets lost three babies on Monday when only about 20 weeks pregnant and doctors said the outlook for the others was bleak.
"Sadly she has lost three babies and the situation for the others is bleak," said Donald Gibb, a consultant obstetrician at London's King's College Hospital.
Doctors had warned Mary Allwood that she faced a major risk of premature deliveries or miscarriage after she decided to go ahead with all eight births.
She became pregnant after undertaking fertility treatment. Tests in July revealed she was bearing eight children.
Allwood then hired a publicist who negotiated a series of media and sponsorship contracts for her.
She has a five-year-old son from a previous marriage and has suffered from a history of high blood pressure during pregnancy.
